summary: Mixed 2.4/2.6 upgrade: start with a 2.4 and a 2.6 inventory, merge the 2.4 one into the 2.6 one (including the gateway host), run the upgrade only on the merged file, and use external databases for both; managed databases must first move to external.
questions: How do I merge 2.4 and 2.6 inventories for an upgrade?
Do I need an external database for the mixed 2.4 and 2.6 upgrade?
Must the gateway host be in the merged inventory?
